sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Bike Happy Sharing
facts: 김녕해수욕장에서 오조리까지 이어지는 약 28km 길이의 제주 북동부 해안도로다.
제주 바다와 독특한 자연, 설화, 생태, 지역 풍경을 만날 수 있는 길이다.
Nearby are Byeolbangseong, Tokkiseom, Hadori Reservoir and Jongdalri Haesindang; seasonal flowers form a flower road.
The official guide recommends driving, cycling and walking; its 17.5 km Handong-ri to Ojori section is described as a safe and beautiful bicycle route.

theme.mountain.rationale: The public guide defines an ocean-side road, not a mountain visit.

theme.ocean.rationale: It is an ocean-side coastal road beginning at Gimnyeong Beach.

theme.activity.rationale: Driving, cycling, and walking are explicit official use modes.

theme.culture_history.rationale: The road is not a heritage site itself, but it connects official-listed folklore and historical sites.

theme.theme_park.rationale: It is a public road and bicycle route, not a theme park.

theme.cafe.rationale: The official description establishes a coastal-route experience, not a cafe destination.

theme.traditional_market.rationale: No market or retail function is documented.

theme.festival.rationale: Seasonal flowers are documented, but no festival is the visit purpose.

environment.indoor_ratio.rationale: This is an outdoor coastal road for driving, cycling and walking.

environment.weather_sensitivity.rationale: Its core route and scenery experience is outdoors.

style_evidence.restfulness.rationale: Sea, seasonal flowers and varied scenery support a slow scenic experience.

style_evidence.physical_ease.hold_reason: No route-wide evidence on footpaths, grades, or barrier-free access was found.
style_evidence.physical_ease.rationale: Vehicle use is possible but general walking accessibility cannot be inferred.

style_evidence.visit_duration_flexibilit.rationale: Visitors can select short segments or the full 28 km route across several travel modes.

style_evidence.scenic_value.rationale: The official guide calls it one of Jeju's most beautiful coastal roads and documents varied scenery and flower roads.

style_evidence.distinctiveness.rationale: It links northeast-coast nature, folklore, ecology and local sites as a designated quality bicycle route.

style_evidence.local_embeddedness.rationale: It passes multiple Gujwa coastal villages and is documented with Jeju-specific nature, folklore, ecology and fishing-village belief.

style_evidence.landmark_significance.rationale: It is an officially promoted quality route and representative coastal road, but independent landmark designation was not found.

style_evidence.photo_value.rationale: Officially documented sea scenery and seasonal canola, crinum, hydrangea, silver grass and wildflower views support photo appeal.

derived_style.discovery_explorer.hold_reason: Existing derived rule has no place-specific input.

common_rule_proposals.proposal: For long coastal routes, do not raise physical_ease only because driving, cycling and walking are possible; retain 0.5 needs_review without route-wide footpath, grade or barrier-free evidence.
